findings.title: Credentialed CORS origin reflection
findings.evidence: server/middleware/mediaErrorMiddleware.ts previously reflected Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials true.
findings.implementedRemediation: Centralized CORS policy now allowlists admin origins and never grants credentials to arbitrary origins.
findings.verificationMethod: npm run security:headers / npm run security:cors

findings.title: Missing centralized browser security headers
findings.implementedRemediation: Added CSP, frame, MIME, permissions, referrer, COOP/CORP, and DNS-prefetch headers to JSON responses.

findings.title: Admin mutation origin validation not centralized
findings.implementedRemediation: Admin mutation requests with unapproved Origin are rejected before route handling.

findings.title: Admin MFA not implemented
findings.recommendedRemediation: Require MFA for privileged production administrators through TOTP/WebAuthn or identity-provider MFA.
findings.implementedRemediation: Documented as launch blocker or approved time-bounded exception requirement.

findings.title: Malware scanning provider not configured
findings.recommendedRemediation: Integrate malware scanner or approve compensating control before accepting public launch upload workflow.
findings.implementedRemediation: Config health warns and launch decision records residual risk.
